rules.statement: An appeal to the District Court under Section 34 of the Estate Duty Ordinance allows an appellant to lead evidence when contesting the validity of an order of assessment passed by the Commissioner.
rules.supporting_quote: "A PPEAL to the District Court under sect on 34 of the Estate Duty Ordinance an appellant was entitled to lead evidence when he came before the District Court to contest the validity of an order of assessment passed by the Commissioner."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 34 of the Estate Duty Ordinance {Cap. 187) as amended by Ordinances 76 of 1938 and 8 of 1941--Sections 34, 36A, 39, 40, 73.
